baseline_models.focus_anchor: ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَخَاهُ ... إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ أَخُوكَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Drawing the man toward Joseph and naming the relation twice makes proximity a restoration of relation: Joseph does not merely receive a visitor but relocates him inside acknowledged brotherhood.

activation_trace.role: Joining toward a gathering point makes Joseph the immediate locus of shelter.
The repeated kin relation converts proximity into restored reciprocal brotherhood.

changed_reading.before: Joseph received his brother and identified himself.
changed_reading.after: Joseph's reception is relational re-housing: the man is gathered from the brothers' group into an explicitly reciprocal bond with Joseph.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ أَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance joins identity, compassionate attention, and a prohibition of distress, so saying 'I am your brother' performs safety rather than merely transmitting information.

activation_trace.role: The concern carried by saying turns the declaration into active care for the hearer.
Compassion supplies the affective force behind drawing the brother close.
Negating harm makes the imperative an assurance of safety, not a rebuke for feeling.

changed_reading.before: Joseph tells his brother who he is and tells him not to be sad.
changed_reading.after: The identification itself is a protective speech-act: acknowledged kinship becomes the reason the brother can inhabit a no-harm space.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ ... قَالَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A group entry narrows to one person drawn inward, after which identity held within is selectively voiced. The syntax creates an interior register inside the public arrival.

activation_trace.role: The inward and secret side of entry opens a concealed register within the group's arrival.
Selective gathering narrows the plural arrival to a one-to-one disclosure space.
The inward-speech branch supplies identity kept unvoiced until it is released to this hearer.

changed_reading.before: The brothers enter, and Joseph then speaks to one brother.
changed_reading.after: The entry contains a selective disclosure chamber: concealed identity crosses from Joseph's interior knowledge into the brother's shared knowledge.

baseline_models.mechanism: Past temporal extension plus intentional action and interpersonal dealing makes the object of grief a sustained mode of conduct, not one detachable incident.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence across past time gives the conduct duration and recurrence.
Purposive action keeps the conduct attributable rather than accidental.
Interpersonal dealing expands the grief-object from isolated deeds to a practiced relational pattern.

changed_reading.before: The brother should not grieve over particular things the others did.
changed_reading.after: He is released from being emotionally governed by their accumulated, intentional way of dealing with people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier encounter establishes one-sided recognition: Joseph distinguishes the brothers while they fail to recognize him. The focus disclosure selectively converts that asymmetry into shared identity for one brother without dissolving the outer concealment.

activation_trace.role: The hidden interior of entry provides a protected layer beneath public encounter.
Repeated kinship is the precise identity transferred into shared recognition.
Recognition by a distinguishing sign establishes Joseph's prior epistemic advantage.
Nonrecognition preserves the public side of the identity asymmetry.

structural_cues: 12:58 and 12:69 repeat a plural entry upon Joseph, but 12:69 narrows the group to one brother and direct first-person disclosure.
The doubled kin term in the focus marks the exact content moved from unilateral knowledge to mutual knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one-sided recognition and later selective disclosure; I infer a controlled transfer of identity inside continuing concealment. A live alternative is a purely emotional reunion with no strategic function.

changed_reading.before: Joseph privately identifies himself after the group arrives.
changed_reading.after: Joseph creates a pocket of mutual recognition inside a larger field of misrecognition; brotherhood is shared knowledge before it is public fact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, the brother is made a condition of measured provision and access, then entrusted to guardians whose promise is shadowed by failed trust. Joseph's drawing him 'to himself' and negating harm transfers him from exchange value and delegated protection into immediate compassionate refuge.

activation_trace.role: Compassion turns proximity to Joseph into personal care rather than mere hospitality.
The no-harm assurance marks the emotional result of the custody transfer.
Comparison and exchange make the absent brother part of a negotiated provisioning relation.
Denied nearness makes access itself conditional on bringing the brother.
Promised guardianship supplies the delegated protection whose adequacy is contested.
Trust as settled safety exposes the father's inability to rest in the brothers' custody.
Tender mercy supplies a protection model that exceeds the brothers' verbal pledge.

structural_cues: The brother first functions as the condition for grain and renewed approach, then becomes the object of competing claims to protection.
The focus replaces plural promises about guarding him with Joseph's singular spatial act and direct assurance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional exchange, disputed guardianship, mercy, and Joseph's 'to himself'; I infer a transfer of the locus of safety from group promise to Joseph's person. The ordinary-hospitality reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: Joseph welcomes and comforts the brother brought by the others.
changed_reading.after: Joseph removes a person treated as an access-token from the exchange circuit and personally re-houses him under compassionate kinship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits between two conceal-and-discover operations involving travel containers. Within that material sequence, Joseph discloses the true hidden content, brotherhood, to the brother before a planted object produces a false public classification. The human inwardness of entry becomes an epistemic container.

activation_trace.role: The concealed interior of entry lets the focus become an inward disclosure nested within public movement.
Inward content becoming selectively speakable provides the identity-side of concealment and reveal.
Deliberate placement changes travel gear into a carrier of information unknown to its bearers.
Opening a closure converts prior concealment into discovery.
The travel pack becomes a second hidden carrier, now attached specifically to the brother.
Material containment supplies the repeated inside from which public evidence will emerge.
Bringing a hidden thing outward completes the public discovery mechanism.

structural_cues: Merchandise is concealed in travel gear at 12:62 and discovered on opening at 12:65.
At 12:69 identity is disclosed inwardly; at 12:70 an object is placed in the brother's pack and at 12:76 extracted publicly.
True identity and false accusation therefore travel through opposed reveal sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated placements, closures, openings, and extraction; I supply the analogy from material container to concealed identity. The live alternative is that the object sequence merely brackets an unrelated reunion.

changed_reading.before: The reunion is an affectionate pause between provisioning episodes.
changed_reading.after: The reunion is the sequence's truthful inner reveal: the brother receives his real identity before a container-generated spectacle assigns him a false public one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, entry is multiplied across separate gates to satisfy an inward paternal need. The repeated entry at 12:69 then reverses the vector: public dispersion culminates in Joseph gathering one separated kin-member toward himself.

activation_trace.role: Movement toward a gathering locus supplies the counter-motion to prior dispersion.
Kinship specifies what the converging motion restores.
Repeated physical entry establishes the route-management sequence inherited by the focus.
Multiple access thresholds make the group's arrival intentionally distributed.
Scattering into parts supplies the outward vector that Joseph's gathering reverses.
Need supplies the pressure behind the otherwise puzzling management of entry.
The inward faculty locates that pressure beneath the visible route pattern.
Effecting and completing the need closes the dispersed-entry phase before Joseph's inward gathering.

structural_cues: The imperative pair 'do not enter from one gate / enter from separate gates' is fulfilled in 12:68.
The focus repeats the entry formula but shifts attention from distributed routes to one brother drawn toward one person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate dispersion, an inward need, completion, and immediate singular gathering; I infer a spatial reversal from managed separation to kin convergence. The live alternative is that the gate instructions are only logistical background.

changed_reading.before: After following their father's entry instructions, the group reaches Joseph and he welcomes his brother.
changed_reading.after: The scattered public arrival reaches its hidden relational destination when Joseph gathers one separated brother into a single center of kinship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The private declaration and consolation immediately precede a public announcement, attribution of theft, negotiated penalty, and an explicitly named stratagem that enables Joseph to retain his brother. The focus can therefore operate simultaneously as retrospective consolation and as emotional briefing before the brother must inhabit a false public role.

activation_trace.role: Concern embedded in the utterance makes the disclosure preparation for the hearer's coming strain.
The grief branch names the affect that the private assurance preemptively contains.
Interpersonal dealing allows past conduct to resonate with the transaction-like operation about to unfold.
Public notification creates the outer speech register opposed to Joseph's selective disclosure.
Attribution of theft supplies the false social identity the brother will have to bear.
Action answered by penalty turns the accusation into an operative retention rule.
The named stratagem confirms that the public sequence is a designed mechanism.
Custodial seizure supplies the practical outcome hidden behind the accusation.
A governing order supplies the constraint that the stratagem must work through.

structural_cues: The intimate 'I am your brother' directly precedes provisioning, placement, and a public accusation.
The penalty is elicited from the brothers and then used to retain the very brother privately reassured in the focus.
12:76 explicitly labels a designed means and contrasts it with what Joseph could do under the king's order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, public misclassification, penalty, design, and retention; I infer that the focus speech prepares the brother emotionally for the operation. A materially live alternative keeps 'what they had been doing' wholly retrospective and treats the later plan as unknown to him.

changed_reading.before: Joseph consoles his brother only about the brothers' prior conduct.
changed_reading.after: Without losing that retrospective sense, the speech also reads as a private identity-anchor given before public theater makes the brother appear guilty so that he can be retained.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material tether branch of the kin root and aligns it with bonds and custody. It remains anchored in the focus's doubled brother-word and the later taking of that brother, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for relation becoming operative, not as the lexical meaning of 'brother.'

activation_trace.role: A fastening tie turns named brotherhood into a relation capable of holding someone close.
Binding materializes the earlier promise as a tie that can secure or constrain.
Custody makes the relational tie operational in the plot's outcome.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood is a recovered family identity.
changed_reading.after: At image level, naming brotherhood fastens a protective tie that the subsequent legal mechanism converts into continued physical attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because a vessel-root contributes a bone-knitting image and a separation-root contributes fracture-like distance. It remains anchored in Joseph's act of gathering his brother and in repeated kinship, but it should be rendered as a branch-induced healing analogy, never as a claim that the travel containers literally signify bones.

activation_trace.role: Joining toward shelter supplies the closing motion of reunion.
Kinship identifies the relation whose separated edges are being restored.
A separated piece supplies the fracture-side of the analogy.
Knitting after break supplies a repair process rather than mere juxtaposition.

changed_reading.before: Joseph gives his brother temporary shelter.
changed_reading.after: The gathering can be carried as an image of fractured kinship beginning to knit, even while the wider family remains separated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping rather than the ordinary speech target. It remains anchored at qāla and converges visibly with 'do not grieve'; downstream prose should qualify it as a sound-and-branch image of speech bearing someone through fear, never as a substitute lexical gloss for qāla.

activation_trace.role: Bearing and rising let the act of saying carry the hearer under emotional load.
Tremor supplies the destabilized state that the utterance counters.
Grief keeps the alternate-root image attached to an explicit affective anchor.

changed_reading.before: Joseph verbally tells his brother not to grieve.
changed_reading.after: At a contained sound-image level, Joseph's saying bears and steadies a brother shaken by grief.

strongest_changes: One-sided recognition becomes selectively shared identity inside continuing public concealment.
A brother treated as a condition of exchange and disputed custody is moved into Joseph's immediate compassionate refuge.
The focus becomes the truthful inner reveal between two material conceal-and-discover operations.
The consolation can remain retrospective while also serving as an identity-anchor before public accusation and legal retention.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah is a hinge where managed entrances, hidden contents, kin naming, and no-grief speech converge. Its readings need not collapse: refuge, selective recognition, reversal of dispersion, truthful disclosure amid manufactured evidence, and contained tether or healing images can coexist at different confidence levels.
remaining_uncertainties: The anticipatory force of the consolation is abductive; the past construction can remain wholly about earlier conduct.
The container-to-hidden-identity and fracture-to-knitting correspondences may be packet-activated analogies rather than intended structural signals.
The non-dominant q-l-l activation is useful only as qualified sound imagery and should not control translation.
